editorial.blurb: A Chinatown institution where generations go for exceptional dim sum and family-style Cantonese cooking, served with efficient precision by staff who prioritize hot food over small talk.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for breakfast to access the larger dim sum menu, or arrive late Saturday night to skip the usual wait—either way, order family-style and get everything: dumplings, steamed buns, potstickers, a veggie dish, fried rice or noodles, and a specialty like Peking Duck.
